heroLead: There’s a place for you here.
heroBody: Come for the Word. Lift your voice in worship. Find warmth in community.
welcomeBody: Whether you have followed Jesus for years, have questions about faith, or are simply looking for a church to call home, there is a place for you at TELL Church.
welcomeShortBody: TELL Church is a joyful, multicultural family growing through Scripture, worship, and life together. Come as you are and take your next step with Jesus.
welcomeQuote: Word that shapes us. Worship that lifts us. Warmth that welcomes us.
currentMessageBody: Biblical teaching for everyday life—clear, hopeful, and centered on Jesus. Our online sermon library is being prepared and will be connected here soon.
messageCaption: Teaching rooted in Scripture and made for real life.
aboutLead: Come encounter God’s Word, worship with freedom, and find a community that feels like family.
aboutBody: We are a joyful, multicultural church where every generation can grow in faith, discover purpose, and take a next step with Jesus.
ministriesTitle: There is room for every generation.
ministriesBody: Faith grows through people who know your name, pray with you, and walk beside you.

ministries.name: Children
ministries.description: A safe, joyful place where children learn the Bible and know they are loved.

ministries.name: Youth
ministries.description: Honest faith, strong friendships, and room for the next generation to lead.

ministries.name: Adults
ministries.description: Grow through Scripture, prayer, fellowship, and meaningful relationships.

ministries.name: Outreach
ministries.description: Put faith into action by serving our neighbors in Rapid City and beyond.

nextSteps.title: Plan a Visit
nextSteps.text: We can’t wait to meet you.

visitBody: Start with fellowship and Sunday School at 11:30 AM, then stay for worship at 12:30 PM. Come as you are—we would love to meet you.
